reviews.verdict: Pediatric musculoskeletal care preserves anatomy/laterality, growth and skeletal maturity, source measurements and functional baseline. • Removal
• Replacement
• Follow-up Requirements

Critical implant information can be available for authorized future care.

Safety:
Supports device recall and surveillance workflows when appropriate data sources are available.

Status:
Documentation

---
reviews.verdict: Device recall support requires authoritative manufacturer/model/lot evidence and response acknowledgement. MRI-related context is not generic compatibility clearance; unknown lot must not yield a negative recall match.
